name: Panel & Cabinet Keys
description: Electrical panels, data cabinets, fire alarm control panels, and HVAC control boxes throughout commercial buildings typically use a small set of common key types — CH751, CH501, 1284X, and similar — that open the majority of utility boxes across many manufacturers. Carrying an assortment of panel and cabinet keys provides access to network infrastructure, building systems, and physical security hardware in a wide range of commercial environments.

blue.det: Individual accessing utility panels without clear authorization; key in use that matches generic panel key profile.
blue.cm: Replace keyed-alike panel hardware with unique locks or electronic access; restrict panel key distribution; audit who holds master keys; monitor utility panel access with cameras.
